title: Entry ids stop embedding the applicant's email; erasure frees the identity
deviations_from_card: (1) Acceptance 1-7 kept verbatim plus the critic's LEGACY-erased case (id m-appl-tomas-example-invalid-job-1, contact/key NULL, anonymized -> created:true with a fresh id, row byte-identical, no re_applied, no ack) plus one extra: an erased row's MASKED label is not an identity (findApplicationByApplicant now skips anonymized_at rows; without that a no-email applicant typing 'Jana N.' matched the erased row and a channel repeat re-consented it). Case 7 (live legacy row found by contact) was green before and after, as intended. (2) Write set grew by tests + one comment only: app/_lib/db/pipeline-readd-transition.test.ts (db-pipeline-store/A's ATS case) and app/_lib/ats/ingest.test.ts pinned the OLD accident that an erased person re-imported through a FORGOTTEN ATS link landed on the scrubbed row (via the email-bearing id) and answered 'erased'. They now pin the new truth (a separate entry, outcome 'created') and still forbid the defect (the scrubbed row is never reopened, refilled or re-linked). While the ats_links row exists (the normal case) the sync still answers 'erased' - unchanged, and the ats_links erasure-exemption note already predicted a forgotten link re-imports as new. app/_lib/ats/ingest.ts: 3-line header comment only. app/api/apply/[id]/filing-core-door.test.ts + reapply-capability-gate.test.ts: one fixture line each (dedupeKey -> applicantKey literal). (3) Surrogate id uses randomId('appl') (house helper for internal PKs): m-[ws-]appl-<time36>-<rand6>-<job>; used for EVERY filing-core entry including anonymous ('' key never dedupes). (4) The UNIQUE catch is defense in depth: inside the IMMEDIATE tx the keyed lookup already sees any committed winner, so the catch is not reachable in a unit test; case 4 exercises the lookup. (5) apply-intake.test.ts: the 7 applyDedupeKey cases deleted with the function (card step 2).
notes: Rebased onto db-pipeline-store/A as the critic asked: findExisting (keyed lookup or derived id) + surrogate id + SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE catch all run inside createPipelineEntry's .immediate() tx; the existing-row branch became landOnExisting(row) so a keyed hit gets the same fill-only backfills and readdReopenDecision (apply door passes no reopen, so a rejected row stays rejected; anonymized rows are unreachable since erasure NULLs applicant_key). core.ts: one ALTER appended AFTER devcase-session-api's key_hash line, and the partial UNIQUE index right after that ALTER loop. perf: base+my files alone measured clean for every route/entry (comments trimmed until job-ingest.ts fit: 424403 B vs 414 KB ceiling, only ~45 B headroom left there for siblings touching core.ts); app/page.tsx +325 B tipped 8941 -> 8942 by rounding, so aa8be5a24 raises that ceiling +1 KB under the lock with a why (measured git archive 2aede6d90 vs a3ae23c90). Live-tree/HEAD test:perf is red from commits landed after mine (comms-dispatch-relay offer-letter preview, pipeline-move-bulk-operations arrival plan: page.tsx 8949 KB, several 3078+ routes +2-4 KB) - not this card's share. test:unit exit 1: python-runner-concurrency.test.ts (pre-existing BROKEN, process-tree kill, reported by db-pipeline-store/A too) and one FLAKE in the same file on the second run; the first run also had offer-link-locale.test.ts red from comms-dispatch-relay's then-uncommitted comms-dispatch.ts (since committed). Every touched-dir suite green (_lib/db/pipeline* 108, ats 52, *intake* 140, *erasure* 13, apply routes 23, apply-intake 84, filing 13+6+2). tsc 0 outside kpi-sim/. Stale prose left outside the write set: app/api/apply/[id]/route.ts:146 and a few comments there still say 'dedupeKey'/'applyDedupeKey' (comments only). Behavior note for the coordinator: every new inbound entry id is now m-appl-<random>-<job>; nothing in app/ or e2e/ parses the old shape (grep), docs/features/comms/outbound-export.md shows an old-shape example ref only.
